prerequisites.reason: no L11 specification exists in the repository

prerequisites.name: trial-granular instrumentation for novel/mixed-cue arms
prerequisites.reason: forced-bank sweeps store aggregate-only rows; ambiguous-cue decisions would be unobservable

prerequisites.name: declare composition semantics (rule) in the protocol text
prerequisites.reason: without a declared rule, mixed-cue results are unfalsifiable

prerequisites.name: port or formally exclude test_phase1_affinity
prerequisites.reason: Windows-only DWORD_PTR; currently neither pass nor fail

carried_limitations: L10.4 one-trial anomaly unresolved; the context-ignoring null has a known sub-0.001 uncertainty

specification_readiness.l10_quality: strong: frozen criteria, revision log, owner decisions, additive diffs verified
specification_readiness.risk: ungoverned thresholds if work starts before a spec is frozen

known_friction: no cmake in this environment; explicit g++ -O2 -std=c++17 -Isrc
harness --mode restart writes to cwd; per-seed --out required

architectural_readiness.context_lever_scope: bank selection only; no within-bank or feature-level modulation
architectural_readiness.gap: no representation for a cue that is partially task A and partially task B

regression_readiness.rating: inherited, not re-executed, with one hole
regression_readiness.implication: an L11 that changes routing must ship behavioural tests

implementation_readiness.work_needed: instrumentation and a new protocol, not build infrastructure

acceptance_design_readiness.template: separately registered criterion, analytically defined metric, measured null, per-seed plus pooled reporting, explicit what-a-PASS-does-not-mean
lessons_carried: define metrics against a measured null, not an absolute accuracy floor (L10-E is floored at ~1/3 by the task draw; perfect router passes only 15.12% of the time)
make rare deviations observable rather than explained away

rejected_candidates.more_capacity_or_banks: capacity already at ceiling with zero forgetting
rejected_candidates.within_bank_context_modulation: genuine gap but requires a new mechanism; needs a scoping study first
rejected_candidates.longer_horizons_or_scale_up: cannot be evaluated honestly before the composition gap is characterised

proposal.title: Cross-Signature Compositional Generalization
proposal.label: PROPOSED
proposal.capability: when a cue mixes features of more than one learned signature, resolve it deterministically and consistently with a declared rule, and preserve correct within-bank readout from the resolved bank
proposal.architectural_justification: context acts at exactly one level (cue -> bank); a mixed cue leaves the router's argmax undefined, which is what L10.3 measured (0.5611 pooled, 0.0 minimum, task-order dependent)

minimum_viable_scope.seeds: 3 primary + 4 exploratory, two held out from tuning
minimum_viable_scope.phase_1: measurement only; phase 2 mechanism only if a specific deficit is identified in a separate specification
minimum_viable_scope.declared_rule: R-majority: bank whose task signature shares the most features wins; ties -> lowest bank index

metrics.Comp(t): fraction of mixed-cue trials whose resolved bank equals the R-majority prediction
metrics.Null(t): mean accuracy over forced-bank trials with cue removed (measured null, as L10-K1)
metrics.Read(t): readout accuracy restricted to trials where the resolved bank was correct

held_out: novel cue combinations never trained on

requirements.determinism: two full reruns byte-identical across all seeds
requirements.persistence: checkpoint save/resume exact per L10-H method
requirements.regression: 26/26 with zero new failures; test_phase1_affinity resolved or formally excluded; L10 criteria unchanged and not reinterpreted
requirements.provenance: every artifact manifested and hashed at creation; no post-hoc repair

fixed_pass_fail_proposed_requires_owner_.L11-A: Comp(t) >= 0.90 on every task on every seed
fixed_pass_fail_proposed_requires_owner_.L11-B: MixAcc(t) - Null(t) >= 0.50 on at least two of three tasks on every seed
fixed_pass_fail_proposed_requires_owner_.L11-C: MixAcc pooled >= 0.75 and no seed/task cell below 0.50
fixed_pass_fail_proposed_requires_owner_.L11-F: regression: no new failures vs L10 baseline

genuine_failure_definitions: a criterion missed under frozen thresholds with the protocol as written
Comp high but MixAcc low -> retrieval failure
Comp low but MixAcc high -> specification failure (the rule was wrong, not the model)
held-out seed failing while training seeds pass -> generalization failure, reported not averaged away
redesign_triggers_not_threshold_adjustme: Comp < 0.60 on a majority of seeds -> single-level router cannot express composition; add compositional cue representation or two-stage routing
Read fails while Comp passes -> composition is disturbing within-bank retrieval
held-out seeds fail systematically -> evaluation split is doing the work
proposal.threshold_adjustment_policy: never a response to a miss; only via a new versioned specification with an owner decision published before revised-threshold evidence exists, preserving the original threshold and result; structural inability to measure requires a new separate criterion

anomaly_diagnostic.if_never_run: L11 specification must state the null carries a quantified sub-0.001 uncertainty

execution_sequence: P4: port or record exclusion of test_phase1_affinity
P2: add opt-in per-trial instrumentation (default off), verified by rerunning the L10 K1 arm and confirming byte-identical aggregate CSVs
P1/P3: write and freeze L11 protocol + specification v1.0 with declared composition rule; owner ratification
